understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked + at the same time; a level is won only when all goals are occupied simultaneously.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces can be selected with CLICK using grid coordinates, and movement actions move the selected piece through the grid. Walls and obstacles block movement, and attempted moves or clicks into blocked positions have no effect while still consuming a step. Multiple selectable pieces must be positioned carefully without moving one off a goal.
